item.title: Implement specified atomic ledger and focused tests
item.brief:
Implement `ledger.py` according to the repository's `SPEC.md`, preserve its documented API, cover every specified error and boundary case, add focused tests beyond the existing basics, use only the Python standard library, and commit the work. Acceptance criteria:
- Constructor accepts only a dict with nonempty string names and built-in integer balances in [0, MAX_BALANCE], permits empty dict, rejects bool and invalid values with ValueError, and copies input.
- `transfer` validates amount first (built-in int only, 1..MAX_BALANCE; bool rejected), then raises KeyError for either unknown account. Never create accounts.
- Return False without mutation for insufficient funds or destination overflow; successful transfer updates exact amounts and preserves total. Same-account transfer validates amount and account, returns whether funds suffice, and never changes balance, including at MAX_BALANCE.
- All operations on one ledger are linearizable across threads: account checks and both writes are atomic, snapshots cannot observe half a transfer, and opposite-direction transfers cannot deadlock. Use standard-library synchronization.
- `snapshot()` returns an independent dict. Add deterministic, focused tests for validation, error ordering, boundaries, copy isolation, and concurrency behavior without random inputs, wall-clock calculations, or external services.
- Run the relevant tests and commit the completed work.

pr.body: Added a per-ledger RLock protecting transfer account checks, overflow/funds checks, both writes, and snapshot copying. Constructor and transfer validation follow SPEC.md, including built-in integer checks, error ordering, same-account behavior, and defensive copies. Added focused validation, boundary, immutability, copy-isolation, and concurrent opposite-transfer/snapshot tests using only the standard library. Verification: python -B -m unittest discover -v (12 passed); git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD (passed). No build or lint configuration exists in this repository. Three independent whole-change reviews read base f05ff0604e44818ba092e67dd3bd1b7a3c750cc6 through head 2cc81e5c886c634617c7e6a081e842b8d2c7d38a; all passed with no findings. No advisory findings remain. Assumption: names may be string subclasses; balances and amounts must be exact built-in ints per the specification.
pr.summary: Implemented bounded, atomic ledger transfers and independent snapshots. Before: ledger methods were unimplemented; now: validation, failure handling, and concurrent use are covered by 12 focused tests.
pr.title: implement atomic ledger transfers

reviewer.why: The change coordinates concurrent state mutation and snapshots. The implementation uses one lock around account checks, overflow checks, both writes, and snapshot copying, so the reviewed paths are serialized; opposite transfers acquire no additional locks and cannot form a lock-order cycle.

risk.why: ledger.py introduces synchronized shared-state mutation and snapshot behavior; tests cover concurrent opposite transfers and snapshot totals. All three reviewers confirmed high risk because linearizability depends on the shared lock being retained by every transfer and snapshot operation.
